headline: Result Update

highlights: Investment Rationale: • Diversified retail franchise to sustain healthy growth : LTF’s diversified retail franchise continues to support healthy business momentum, with moderation in rural disbursement amid uneven monsoons being offset by traction across Urban, SME and Gold Finance.
Accelerated expansion in Gold Finance through branch additions, normalisation in PL post implementation of Cyclops and calibrated pick-up in rural businesses should provide incremental growth levers.
Focus on prime customers, coupled with disciplined guardrails across businesses, should enable risk-calibrated growth while maintaining portfolio quality.

We expect ~24% CAGR in AUM over FY26-28E. • Resilient margins to support earnings trajectory : Despite shift towards prime customers, NIM + fee income remained resilient at 10.48%, aided by liability management resulting in cost of borrowing declining below 7%.
valuation: Rating and Target Price : Diversified growth opportunities across retail businesses, coupled with calibrated recovery in rural lending and continued focus on prime customers, should support healthy AUM growth.
We assign a target price of ₹325, valuing LTF at ~2.3x FY28E BV, and recommend BUY rating.
ICICI Direct assigns ratings to its stocks according to their notional target price vs. current market price and then categorizes them as Buy, Hold, Reduce and Sell.
watch: Focus on prime customers, coupled with disciplined guardrails across businesses, should enable risk-calibrated growth while maintaining portfolio quality.

However, exposure to drought-affected regions at ~3% of the rural book remains a monitorable, as potential El Niño-led stress could delay credit cost normalisation and moderate the pace of RoA improvement.
